company.name: Nilus
company.shortDescription: Nilus is a cash management platform that automates reconciliation and payment workflows.
company.description:
Nilus is a plug-and-play platform that automates reconciliation, reporting, and payment workflows to empower finance teams with financial transparency and complete control.

By unifying data from your payment providers, banks, platform, and ERP, Nilus creates a single source of financial truth for all your payment activity.

Nilus provides a seamless plug-and-play experience for financial operators. With our automated workflows, pre-built data connectors, and smart reconciliation algorithms, Nilus eliminates dependence on tech teams and spreadsheets to get the job done.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $10,000,000, or 53.76% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $46,257,720 to $79,837,870, a 1.73x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
